title: When people counted you out, God was quietly writing the next chapter.
paragraphs:
When people counted you out, God was quietly writing the next chapter.
Your story isn't over — it's being rewritten by the One who already knows the ending.
Keep walking. Keep trusting. Heaven is still holding the pen. ✨🕊️

“For I know the plans I have for you,” declares the Lord,
“plans to prosper you and not to harm you,
plans to give you hope and a future.” — Jeremiah 29:11
